For positive integers $N$, write $S(N)=\sum_{n=1}^N[x^n]A$ and set
$\beta=\alpha/(1+\alpha)$. There are constants $c',C'>0$ such that
$c'N^\beta\le\log S(N)\le C'N^\beta$ for all sufficiently large $N$.
